method: Files read directly with relative paths inside this directory. Images viewed as images. Raw API responses summarised by structure only (no payer/payee fields printed). private/paypal-sandbox.env NOT read.

three_cases.base: order 9W617404SA497064L, items Front brake pads 300.00 + Labor - brake pad replacement 120.00, qty 1 each, total 420.00; authorize CREATED 2EW06525V43333841; capture 11N48879VB407822M COMPLETED
three_cases.addon: order 7LW99203JC999730T, Upper radiator hose 38.00 + Labor - hose replacement (0.5h) 65.00, total 103.00; authorization 7RF396421S705910K; capture 9AH41168XG2816112 COMPLETED final_capture=true
three_cases.cancel: order 4WU00504YJ9406212, Air filter - cancellation test 25.00 qty 1; buyer approved, authorize CREATED 9TP190692X3263024, then void -> GET VOIDED. Capture never called. This was approved/held then cancelled, not an initial refusal.

observations.collapsed_item_details: actual-sandbox-results.json buyer_item_ui.default_item_display=COLLAPSED_EXPAND_REQUIRED; JPGs/TXT show the 주문 세부정보 (order details) section only after it was expanded (AX tree marks the button as expanded). Item list sits below payment method selection.
observations.amount_change_note: All three PayPal review screens show above the 주문 검토 button: "이 거래가 완료되면 배송비, 세금 및 구매 업데이트를 반영하기 위해 구매 금액이 변경될 수 있습니다." (purchase amount may change after this transaction). So the PayPal screen alone does not prove an immutable scope or amount.
observations.checkout_balances: Checkout available balance 5000.00 before base, 4580.00 before addon, 4477.00 before cancel. Developer account edit page reportedly still showed 5000 -> not a ledger.
observations.capture_minimal_response: response-1794499542540469000.json (capture POST, 201) contains only id, links, status=COMPLETED - no amount, no final_capture. Probe crashed with KeyError after saving capture ID; GET /v2/payments/captures/11N48879VB407822M returned amount 420.00 final_capture=true. No repeat capture.
observations.authorization_expiry: authorization expiration_time = create + 29 days (e.g. created 2026-11-12T16:05Z, expires 2026-12-11T16:05:23Z). Auth GET links include reauthorize, but reauthorize was not exercised.
observations.orders_completed_after_authorize: POST authorize returns order status COMPLETED while authorization status is CREATED -> order COMPLETED does not mean charged.
observations.cancel_url_behavior: cancel link value 127.0.0.1:8879/cancel?token=<orderId>; return_url similarly carries token=<orderId>.
observations.probe_payload: intent AUTHORIZE, one purchase_unit with reference_id, description, items[name, sku, quantity, unit_amount], amount with breakdown.item_total, payment_source.paypal.experience_context{brand_name, shipping_preference NO_SHIPPING, return_url, cancel_url}; headers PayPal-Request-Id (sha256 run|case|action), Prefer return=representation; host fixed to api-m.sandbox.paypal.com; transport error -> no auto retry.
reviews_applied: server enforces capture == authorized amount; not PayPal
approved-then-cancelled void; initial refusal = no hold, no void
scope approved but PayPal closed state
